verses: Bari kharabi hai naap tol mein kami kerney walon ki
Kay jab logon say naap ker letay hain to poora poora letay hain
Aur jab unhen naap ker ya tol ker detay hain to kum detay hain
Kiya unhen apney marney kay baad ji uthney ka khayal nahi
Uss azeem din kay liye
Jiss din sab log rab aalameen kay samney kharay hun gay
Yaqeenan badkaron ka nama aemaal sijeen mein hai
Tujhay kiya maloom sijeen kiya hai?
(yeh to) likhi hui kitab hai
Uss din jhutlanay walon ki bari kharabi hai
Jo jaza o saza kay din ko jhutlatay rahey
Ussay sirf o hi jhutlata hai jo hadd say aagay nikal janey wala (aur) gunah gaar hota hai
Jab uss kay samney humari aayaten parhi jati hain to keh deta hai kay yeh aglon kay afsaney hain
Yun nahi balkay)yeh unn kay dilon per unn aemaal ki wajah say zang (charh gaya) hai
Hergiz nahi yeh log uss din apney rab say oat mein rakhay jayen gay
Phir yeh log bil-yaqeen jahannum mein jhonkay jayen gay
Phir keh diya jaye ga kay yehi hai woh jissay tum jhutlatay rahey
Yaqeenan yaqeenan neko kaaron ka nama aemaal illieen mein hai
Tujhay kiya pata kay illieen kiya hai?
(woh to) likhi hui kitab hai
Muqarrab (farishtay) uss ka mushahida kertay hain
Yaqeenan nek log (bari) nematon mein hun gay
Masehriyon per bethay dekh rahey hun gay
To unn kay chehron say hi nematon ki tazgi pehchan ley ga
Yeh log sar-ba-mohar khalis sharab pilaye jayen gay
Jiss per mushk ki mehar hogi, sabqat ley janey walon ko ussi mein sabqat kerni chahaiye
Aur uss ki amezish tasneem ki hogi
(yani) woh chashma jiss ka pani muqarrab log piyein gay
Gunehgar log eman walon ki hansi uraya kertay thay
Aur unn kay pass say guzartay huye aapas mein aankh kay isharay kertay thay
Aur jab apney walon ki taraf lottay to dil lageyan kertay thay
Aur jab unhen dekhtay to kehtay yaqeenan yeh log gumrah (bey raah) hain
Yeh unn per pasban bana ker to nahi bhejay gaye
Pus aaj eman walay unn kafiron per hansen gay
Takhton per bethay dekh rahey hun gay
Kay abb unn munkiron ney jaisa yeh kertay thay poora poora badla pa liya
